","사회":"data:image/png;base64,","수학":"data:image/png;base64,","영어":"data:image/png;base64,"});
"use strict";
/* HOJA catalog live Project B adapter. Project A Game.html v1.00.283 is the interaction reference:
   direct single click -> asynchronous question loading; 2-5 cartridge selection
   only when multiselect is explicitly switched ON. Read-only Project B GAS source; no example fallback. */
const HOJA_CATALOG=(()=>{
 let sheetNames=[],stage='grade',grade=null,subject=null,publisher=null;
 let chosen=[],multiSelect=false,liveData=false,lastLaunched=[],repositoryKind="PUBLIC";
 const root=()=>document.getElementById('hojaCatalog');
 const mode=()=>document.getElementById('hojaNextMode');
 const backBtn=()=>document.getElementById('hojaSharedBack');
 const infoPanel=()=>document.getElementById('hcUnitInfoPanel');
  function parse(name){
   // Project B/_SMQ_PUBLIC_CATALOG is the authority for publication. The title is
   // only used to GROUP the authorized entries in the UI (Project A convention).
   const raw=String(name||'').trim();
   if(!raw)return null;
   // 1~6학년, 기타, non-whitelisted subjects; optional legacy semester marker.
   const match=raw.match(/^([1-6]\s*(?:학년)?|기타(?:학년)?)\s*(?:[-_–—|/·]\s*|\s+)(?:(?:[12]\s*학기)\s*(?:[-_–—|/·]\s*)?)?([^\s\-_–—|/·]+)\s*(?:[-_–—|/·]\s*|\s+)(.+)$/u);
   if(!match){
    // Never hide a published but non-standard title: make its unparsed status explicit.
    return {grade:'기타',subject:'미분류',publisher:'',sheetName:raw,label:raw};
   }
   const grade=/^[1-6]/.test(match[1])?String(parseInt(match[1],10)):'기타';
   const subject=match[2].trim(),tail=match[3].trim();
   if(!subject||!tail)return {grade:'기타',subject:'미분류',publisher:'',sheetName:raw,label:raw};
   if(subject==='영어'){
    const publisherAndUnit=tail.match(/^(.+?)\s*[-_–—|/]\s*(.+)$/u);
    return publisherAndUnit
     ? {grade,subject,publisher:publisherAndUnit[1].trim(),sheetName:raw,label:publisherAndUnit[2].trim()}
     : {grade,subject,publisher:'출판사 미구분',sheetName:raw,label:tail};
   }
   return {grade,subject,publisher:'',sheetName:raw,label:tail};
  }
 function rows(){return sheetNames.map(parse).filter(Boolean)}
 function unique(xs){return [...new Set(xs)]}
 function syncBack(){backBtn().hidden=root().hidden&&mode().hidden&&document.getElementById("hojaRepoChoice").hidden}
 function closeInfo(){infoPanel().hidden=true;}
 function openInfo(name){
  document.getElementById('hcUnitInfoName').textContent=String(name);
   requestAnimationFrame(()=>window.HOJA_V051_FIT_INFO?.());
  infoPanel().hidden=false;document.getElementById('hcUnitInfoClose').focus();
 }
 function hide(){root().hidden=true;window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.hide?.();closeInfo();syncBack()}
 function setSheets(names,opts={}){
  sheetNames=Array.isArray(names)?names.map(String).filter(Boolean):[];
  liveData=!opts.demo;repositoryKind=opts.repositoryKind||'PUBLIC';stage='grade';grade=null;subject=null;publisher=null;
  chosen=[];lastLaunched=[];multiSelect=false;closeInfo();
  document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').hidden=true;
  root().hidden=false;window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.hide?.();
   render();syncBack();
 }
 function title(){return ({grade:'학년 선택',subject:'과목 선택',publisher:'영어 출판사 선택',cartridge:'단원 카트리지 선택'})[stage]}
 function context(){return [grade?(grade==='기타'?'기타':grade+'학년'):'',subject,publisher].filter(Boolean).join('  ·  ')}
 function item(label,sub,icon,activate,selected,opts={}){
  const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';
  btn.className='hcPak'+(selected?' isSelected':'')+(opts.unit?' isUnit':'')+(opts.long?' isLong':'')+(opts.grade?' isGrade':'');
  btn.setAttribute('aria-label',label+' '+sub);btn.title=label;
  if(opts.unit&&multiSelect)btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(Boolean(selected)));
  const face=document.createElement('div');face.className='hcFace';
  if(!opts.grade){
   const emblem=document.createElement('div');emblem.className='hcEmblem';
   if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(HOJA_SUBJECT_EMOJI,icon)){
    const image=document.createElement('img');image.className='hcSubjectIcon';image.src=HOJA_SUBJECT_EMOJI[icon];image.width=32;image.height=32;
    image.alt='';image.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');emblem.appendChild(image);
   }else emblem.textContent=icon;
   face.appendChild(emblem);
  }
  const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent=label;
  if(opts.unit){strong.className='hcUnitName';strong.dataset.fullLabel=label;}
  face.appendChild(strong);
  if(!opts.grade&&sub){const small=document.createElement('small');small.textContent=sub;face.appendChild(small)}
  btn.appendChild(face);
  btn.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();activate()};return btn;
 }
 function changeStage(next){stage=next;render()}
 async function loadSelected(names){
  if(!Array.isArray(names)||!names.length||names.length>5)return;
  const requested=names.slice();lastLaunched=requested;
  window.HOJA_LOADING.show({purpose:'questions'});
  try{
   const results=await window.HOJA_B_LIVE.rpc('GET',requested);
   if(!Array.isArray(results)||results.length!==requested.length||
      results.some((v,i)=>v?.sheetName!==requested[i]))throw new Error('응답 카트리지 목록이 요청과 다릅니다.');
   window.HOJA_B_LIVE.setSources(results);
   window.HOJA_LOADING.hide();root().hidden=true;
   document.getElementById('hcNextContext').textContent=context()+' · '+requested.length+'개 공개 카트리지';
   document.getElementById('hcNextSelected').textContent=requested.map(n=>parse(n)?.label||n).join(' · ');
   window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.show?.();syncBack();
  }catch(error){
   window.HOJA_LOADING.hide();root().hidden=false;render();syncBack();
   window.alert('Project B 문제 로딩 실패: '+window.HOJA_B_LIVE.showError(error)+'\n실제 문제를 불러오지 못하여 게임을 시작하지 않습니다.');
  }
 }
 // Long title layout: ONLY break at whitespace, and balance visual widths.
 // This is a display-only transformation. sheetName / original label remains untouched.
 function fitUnitNames(){
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  if(!ctx)return;
  root().querySelectorAll('.hcPak.isUnit .hcUnitName').forEach(el=>{
   const text=String(el.dataset.fullLabel||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
   const words=text?text.split(' '):[];
   const face=el.closest('.hcFace');if(!words.length||!face)return;
   const faceCss=getComputedStyle(face),elCss=getComputedStyle(el);
   const width=Math.max(45,face.clientWidth-12);
   const fixed=Array.from(face.children).filter(node=>node!==el).reduce((n,node)=>n+node.offsetHeight,0);
   const maxHeight=Math.max(33,face.clientHeight-parseFloat(faceCss.paddingTop||'0')-parseFloat(faceCss.paddingBottom||'0')-fixed-16);
   const family=elCss.fontFamily||'sans-serif';
   const weight=elCss.fontWeight||'900';
   const maxWidthAt=(line,size)=>{ctx.font=weight+' '+size+'px '+family;return ctx.measureText(line).width+line.length*.35;};
   const bestPartition=(count,size)=>{
    let best=null;
    const candidates=[];
    if(count===1)candidates.push([text]);
    if(count===2)for(let i=1;i<words.length;i++)candidates.push([words.slice(0,i).join(' '),words.slice(i).join(' ')]);
    if(count===3)for(let i=1;i<words.length-1;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<words.length;j++)candidates.push([words.slice(0,i).join(' '),words.slice(i,j).join(' '),words.slice(j).join(' ')]);
    for(const lines of candidates){
     const widths=lines.map(s=>maxWidthAt(s,size));
     if(widths.some(w=>w>width))continue;
     // Prefer nearly equal amounts of text on both lines (actual rendered width).
     const score=Math.max(...widths)-Math.min(...widths);
     if(!best||score<best.score)best={lines,score,size};
    }
    return best;
   };
   const search=(count,high,low)=>{
    for(let size=high;size>=low;size--){
     if(count*size*1.2>maxHeight)continue;
     const result=bestPartition(count,size);if(result)return result;
    }
    return null;
   };
   // Leave genuinely short titles on one line. Two lines get a larger 14–22px
   // font and balanced word-boundary split. Three lines only when two lines
   // would become too small to read on a cartridge.
   let result=search(1,22,20);
   if(!result){
    const options=[];
    for(let size=22;size>=14;size--){
     if(size*2*1.2>maxHeight)continue;
     const candidate=bestPartition(2,size);
     if(candidate){
      // Strong preference for balanced visual line widths, not an orphan word.
      const lineWidths=candidate.lines.map(line=>maxWidthAt(line,size));
      const imbalance=Math.abs(lineWidths[0]-lineWidths[1])/Math.max(...lineWidths);
      options.push({candidate,imbalance,score:imbalance*80+(22-size)*1.3});
     }
    }
    options.sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score);
    result=options[0]?.candidate||search(3,18,11)||search(2,13,10)||search(1,19,10);
   }
   if(!result){ // Single unbreakable very long token: clip instead of splitting mid-word.
    el.textContent=text;el.style.fontSize='11px';el.style.whiteSpace='nowrap';
    el.style.textOverflow='ellipsis';el.style.overflow='hidden';el.title=text;
    return;
   }
   el.textContent=result.lines.join('\n');
   el.dataset.lineCount=String(result.lines.length);
   el.style.fontSize=result.size+'px';
   el.style.whiteSpace='pre-line';
   el.style.overflow='hidden';
   el.style.textOverflow='clip';
  });
 }
 function render(){
  const rail=document.getElementById('hcRail');const priorScroll=rail.scrollLeft;rail.replaceChildren();
  document.getElementById('hcTitle').textContent=title();
  document.getElementById('hcContext').textContent=context();
  const hint=document.getElementById('hcHint');
  const confirm=document.getElementById('hcConfirm');
  const controls=document.getElementById('hcMultiControls');
  const toggle=document.getElementById('hcMultiToggle');
  const count=document.getElementById('hcMultiCount');
  controls.hidden=stage!=='cartridge';toggle.checked=multiSelect;
  confirm.hidden=!(stage==='cartridge'&&multiSelect);
  confirm.disabled=chosen.length===0;
  confirm.textContent='선택 완료 ('+chosen.length+'/5)';
  count.textContent=multiSelect?'다중 선택 켜짐':'다중 선택 꺼짐';
   if(stage==='grade'){
    hint.textContent='학년을 선택하세요.';
    const availableGrades=unique(rows().map(x=>x.grade)).sort((a,b)=>{
     const an=/^[1-6]$/.test(String(a)),bn=/^[1-6]$/.test(String(b));
     if(an&&bn)return Number(a)-Number(b);
     if(an)return -1;if(bn)return 1;
     return String(a).localeCompare(String(b),'ko');
    });
    for(const g of availableGrades){
     const label=/^[1-6]$/.test(String(g))?g+'학년':String(g);
     rail.appendChild(item(label,'','',()=>{
      grade=g;subject=null;publisher=null;chosen=[];multiSelect=false;changeStage('subject');
     },false,{grade:true}));
    }
    if(!availableGrades.length)hint.textContent='공개된 카트리지가 없습니다.';
   }else if(stage==='subject'){
    hint.textContent='학습할 과목을 고르세요.';
    const items=rows().filter(x=>x.grade===grade);
    const availableSubjects=unique(items.map(x=>x.subject)).sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ko'));
    for(const sub of availableSubjects){
     const n=items.filter(x=>x.subject===sub).length;
     // Existing public cartridges only. No zero-count placeholder cards.
     if(!n)continue;
     rail.appendChild(item(sub,n+'개 카트리지',sub,()=>{
      subject=sub;publisher=null;chosen=[];multiSelect=false;
      changeStage(sub==='영어'?'publisher':'cartridge');
     }));
    }
  }else if(stage==='publisher'){
   hint.textContent='사용 중인 영어 교과서 출판사를 선택하세요.';
   for(const p of unique(rows().filter(x=>x.grade===grade&&x.subject==='영어').map(x=>x.publisher)).sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ko'))){
    const n=rows().filter(x=>x.grade===grade&&x.publisher===p).length;
    rail.appendChild(item(p,n+'개 카트리지','영어',()=>{publisher=p;chosen=[];multiSelect=false;changeStage('cartridge')}));
   }
  }else if(stage==='cartridge'){
   const data=rows().filter(x=>x.grade===grade&&x.subject===subject&&(subject!=='영어'||x.publisher===publisher));
   hint.textContent=multiSelect
    ?chosen.length+'개 선택됨 · 원하는 단원을 선택한 다음 확인을 누르세요.'
    :'카트리지를 누르면 즉시 문제 로딩이 시작됩니다.';
   for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){
    const it=data[i];const selected=chosen.includes(it.sheetName);
    const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='hcPakWrap';
    const b=item(it.label,multiSelect?(selected?'✓ 선택됨':'PAK '+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')):'PAK '+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'),subject,()=>{
     if(!multiSelect){loadSelected([it.sheetName]);return;}
     const idx=chosen.indexOf(it.sheetName);
     if(idx>=0)chosen.splice(idx,1);
     else if(chosen.length<5)chosen.push(it.sheetName);
     else {openInfo('카트리지는 최대 5개까지 선택할 수 있습니다.');return;}
     render();
    },selected,{unit:true,long:it.label.length>19});
    wrap.appendChild(b);
    if(it.label.length>17){
     const full=document.createElement('button');full.type='button';full.className='hcInfoBtn';
     full.textContent='ⓘ';full.title='단원명 전체 보기';
     full.setAttribute('aria-label',it.label+' · 단원명 전체 보기');
     full.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();openInfo(it.label)};
     wrap.appendChild(full);
    }
    rail.appendChild(wrap);
   }
  }
  rail.scrollLeft=priorScroll;
  requestAnimationFrame(fitUnitNames);
 }
 window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!root().hidden)requestAnimationFrame(fitUnitNames);},{passive:true});
 if(document.fonts?.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(()=>{if(!root().hidden)fitUnitNames();});
 function back(){
  if(!infoPanel().hidden){closeInfo();return;}
  if(!mode().hidden){if(window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.back?.()){syncBack();return;}window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.hide?.();root().hidden=false;render();syncBack();return;}
  if(stage==='grade'){hide();window.HOJA_REPOSITORY?.show?.();return;}
  if(stage==='subject'){grade=null;changeStage('grade');return;}
  if(stage==='publisher'){subject=null;publisher=null;changeStage('subject');return;}
  if(stage==='cartridge'){
   chosen=[];multiSelect=false;
   if(subject==='영어'){publisher=null;changeStage('publisher')}else{subject=null;changeStage('subject')}
  }
 }
 document.getElementById('hcMultiToggle')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{
  multiSelect=Boolean(e.target.checked);chosen=[];render();
 });
 document.getElementById('hcConfirm')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  e.stopPropagation();if(multiSelect&&chosen.length)loadSelected(chosen);
 });
 document.getElementById('hcUnitInfoClose')?.addEventListener('click',closeInfo);
 infoPanel()?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===infoPanel())closeInfo()});
 document.getElementById('hojaSharedBack')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();if(window.HOJA_REPOSITORY?.back?.())return;back()});
 return {setSheets,hide,back,resume:()=>{root().hidden=false;render();syncBack();},openInfo,fitUnitNames,syncBack,get state(){return {stage,grade,subject,publisher,multiSelect,chosen:chosen.slice(),lastLaunched:lastLaunched.slice(),liveData,repositoryKind}}};
})();
window.HOJA_CATALOG=HOJA_CATALOG;

</script>
<script>
"use strict";
/* Public/private entry gate matches Project A RC3 navigation semantics.
   Isolated demo ONLY: no actual participation-code verification or private sheet read. */
window.HOJA_REPOSITORY=(()=>{
 let kind=null,busy=false;
 const root=()=>document.getElementById('hojaRepoChoice');
 const panel=()=>document.getElementById('hrPrivatePanel');
 const input=()=>document.getElementById('hrCode');
 const feedback=()=>document.getElementById('hrNotice');
 function syncBack(){const b=document.getElementById('hojaSharedBack');if(b)b.hidden=root().hidden&&document.getElementById('hojaCatalog').hidden&&document.getElementById('hojaNextMode').hidden;}
 function hide(){root().hidden=true;panel().hidden=true;busy=false;feedback().textContent='';feedback().hidden=true;document.getElementById('hrPublic').disabled=false;syncBack();}
 function show(){window.HOJA_LOADING?.hide?.();window.HOJA_CATALOG?.hide?.();window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.hide?.();
  const s=window.HOJA_ATTRACT_SCENE;if(s)s.pausedByUser=true;
  kind=null;busy=false;feedback().textContent='';feedback().hidden=true;input().value='';panel().hidden=true;root().hidden=false;document.getElementById('hrPublic').disabled=false;syncBack();}
 function openPrivate(){if(busy)return;panel().hidden=false;feedback().textContent='개인 카트리지는 아직 Project B 인증 API가 연결되지 않아 사용할 수 없습니다.';feedback().hidden=false;input().focus();}
 async function launch(next){
  if(busy||next!=='PUBLIC')return;busy=true;kind=next;feedback().textContent='';feedback().hidden=true;document.getElementById('hrPublic').disabled=true;root().hidden=true;syncBack();
  window.HOJA_LOADING?.show({purpose:'catalog'});
  try{
   const rows=await window.HOJA_B_LIVE.rpc('LIST');
   if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.some(x=>!x||typeof x.name!=='string'||!x.name.trim())||
      new Set(rows.map(x=>x.name)).size!==rows.length)throw new Error('공개 카트리지 목록 응답 오류');
   const names=rows.map(x=>x.name);
   if(!names.length)throw new Error('게시된 공용 카트리지가 없습니다.');
   // Valid public sheet names are accepted even if their display naming differs.
   window.HOJA_B_LIVE.clear();
   window.HOJA_LOADING?.hide();window.HOJA_CATALOG?.setSheets(names,{repositoryKind:'PUBLIC'});
  }catch(error){window.HOJA_LOADING?.hide();root().hidden=false;syncBack();
    feedback().textContent='공개 카트리지 조회 실패: '+window.HOJA_B_LIVE.showError(error);feedback().hidden=false;}
  finally{busy=false;document.getElementById('hrPublic').disabled=false;}
 }
 function enter(){feedback().textContent='개인 카트리지는 인증 연동 전까지 사용할 수 없습니다.';feedback().hidden=false;}

 function back(){if(root().hidden)return false;hide();window.HOJA_ATTRACT_CONTROL?.restart?.();return true;}
 document.getElementById('hrPublic')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launch('PUBLIC'));
 document.getElementById('hrPrivate')?.addEventListener('click',openPrivate);
 document.getElementById('hrEnter')?.addEventListener('click',enter);
 input()?.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.stopPropagation();enter();}});
 return {show,hide,back,syncBack,get state(){return {kind,busy,visible:!root().hidden}}};
})();

</script>
<script>
"use strict";
/* HOJA V0.5.8 mode selector: four canonical seasonal maps, clean gather/deal, shared layer & ground scroll. TEST only. */
window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW=(()=>{
 let stage='root',selection=null,teamCount=null,lastTime=0,raf=0,elapsed=0,season='spring';
 let busy=false,transitionTimer=0;
 const host=()=>document.getElementById('hojaNextMode');
 const title=()=>document.getElementById('hmTitle');
 const rail=()=>document.getElementById('hmSelections');
 const hint=()=>document.getElementById('hmSelectionHint');
 const asset=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const H=416,G=H-60;let W=960;
 const SEASONS=Object.freeze({
  spring:{name:'봄',sky:'#50bbff',ground:'#885a45',terrain:'paV2Terrain',v2Family:0,bg:['sgSky','sgCloud1','sgCloud2','sgHills','sgForeground']},
  summer:{name:'여름',sky:'#50bbff',ground:'#b27c57',terrain:'paV2Terrain',v2Family:0,bg:['thTroSky','thTroCloudsBG','thTroClouds','thTroWaters']},
  autumn:{name:'가을',sky:'#fff3d8',ground:'#743e45',terrain:'paV2Terrain',v2Family:4,bg:['thAutDistant','thAutRow2','thAutRow1','thAutPiles','thAutTrees','thAutLeafTop']},
  winter:{name:'겨울',sky:'#fff8ff',ground:'#a66567',terrain:'paV2Terrain',v2Family:8,bg:['thWinMountain','thWinHills','thWinFore']}
 });
 const SEASON_KEYS=Object.keys(SEASONS);
 function selectSeason(requested){
   const pick=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SEASONS,requested)
       ? requested : window.HOJA_SEASON_SESSION.current();
   season=pick;
   host().dataset.season=pick;
   host().querySelector('.hmLandscape')?.setAttribute('aria-label',
        'HOJA '+SEASONS[pick].name+' 스테이지 · 호자와 나한상, 몬스터 이동 애니메이션');
 }
 function clearSeason(){delete host().dataset.season;}
 // Every ground actor advances at exactly 53 world px/sec; offsets are deliberately spaced.
 // Hoja original 64x64 WALK is left-facing, so horizontal mirror is required for rightward movement.
 const actors=[
  {key:'hojaModeWalk',frames:8,offset:100,sw:64,sh:64,type:'hoja',sz:64,flip:true},
  {key:'nahanModeWalk',frames:4,offset:400,sw:64,sh:64,type:'nahan',sz:64},
  {key:'enJumpyIdle',frames:2,offset:700,sw:32,sh:32,type:'jumpy',sz:56},
  {key:'enHermieCrawl',frames:2,offset:1000,sw:32,sh:32,type:'hermie',sz:56},
  {key:'enRoachRun',frames:2,offset:1300,sw:32,sh:32,type:'roach',sz:56},
  {key:'enOwlFly',frames:3,offset:1600,sw:32,sh:32,type:'owl',sz:54},
  {key:'enBlankeyFloat',frames:4,offset:1900,sw:32,sh:32,type:'ghost',sz:54}
 ];
 // Seven actors share 53px/sec and form a seamless 7 x 300px loop.
 // Even BLANKEY-to-Hoja wraparound is 300px, so nobody appears isolated.
 const SHARED_SPEED=53, TRAVEL_PERIOD=2100;
 const syncBack=()=>window.HOJA_CATALOG?.syncBack?.();
 function sound(){window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.unlockFromGesture?.();const a=window.HOJA_INTRO_AUDIO;if(a?.enabled)a.play('collect',.42,1.18,65);}
 function button(label,subtitle,next){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='hmPick';const st=document.createElement('strong');st.textContent=label;const sm=document.createElement('small');sm.textContent=subtitle;b.append(st);if(subtitle){b.append(sm)}b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();transitionTo(next)});return b;}
 function transitionTo(commit){
  if(busy)return;busy=true;sound();const buttons=Array.from(rail().querySelectorAll('.hmPick'));
  const bounds=rail().getBoundingClientRect();const centerX=bounds.left+bounds.width/2,centerY=bounds.top+bounds.height/2;
  buttons.forEach(b=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();b.style.setProperty('--hm-gx',Math.round(centerX-(r.left+r.width/2))+'px');b.style.setProperty('--hm-gy',Math.round(centerY-(r.top+r.height/2))+'px');b.classList.add('hmGather');b.disabled=true;});
  transitionTimer=setTimeout(()=>{transitionTimer=0;try{commit();if(!host().hidden)render(true);}finally{busy=false;}},415);
 }
 function render(deal=false){
  const r=rail();r.replaceChildren();r.className='hmSelections';
  if(stage==='root'){
   title().textContent='게임 모드 선택';hint().textContent='원하는 게임 방식을 선택하세요.';
   r.append(button('혼자 놀기','',()=>{stage='solo'}));
   r.append(button('함께 놀기','',()=>{stage='team'}));
  }else if(stage==='solo'){
   title().textContent='혼자 놀기';hint().textContent='도전할 방식을 골라 주세요.';
   r.append(button('아케이드 모드','HOJA 횡스크롤 게임 · 랭킹 등록 기능',()=>{selection='arcade';window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_GATE?.startArcade(()=>window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY.launch('arcade',season))}));
   r.append(button('문제 풀이 모드','무한 문제 풀이 모드',()=>{selection='quiz';window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY.launch('quiz',season)}));
   const practiceCard=button('연습모드','호자 조작법 배우기 · 언제든 다시 연습',()=>{selection='practice';window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_GATE?.open('practice')});
   practiceCard.classList.add('hmPractice');r.append(practiceCard);
  }else if(stage==='team'){
   title().textContent='함께 놀기 · 팀 수 선택';hint().textContent='2~7팀 중 하나를 선택하세요.';r.classList.add('teamCount');
   for(let i=2;i<=7;i++)r.append(button(String(i),i+'팀',()=>{selection='team';teamCount=i;window.HOJA_TEAM_TEST.launch(i,season)}));

  }
  if(deal){
   // Measure the *new* buttons after layout: each travels from the SAME center
   // to its true slot, regardless of 2/6 cards, wrapping or viewport size.
   const rect=r.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=rect.left+rect.width/2,cy=rect.top+rect.height/2;
   Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('.hmPick')).forEach(b=>{
    const p=b.getBoundingClientRect();
    b.style.setProperty('--hm-deal-x',Math.round(cx-(p.left+p.width/2))+'px');
    b.style.setProperty('--hm-deal-y',Math.round(cy-(p.top+p.height/2))+'px');
    b.classList.add('hmDeal');b.addEventListener('animationend',()=>b.classList.remove('hmDeal'),{once:true});setTimeout(()=>{if(b.isConnected)b.classList.remove('hmDeal');},650);
   });
  }
  syncBack();
 }
 function cancel(){if(transitionTimer)clearTimeout(transitionTimer);transitionTimer=0;busy=false;}
 function back(){if(busy){cancel();render();return true;}if(stage==='solo'||stage==='team'){stage='root';render();return true;}return false;}
 function show(requestedSeason){cancel();stage='root';selection=null;teamCount=null;selectSeason(requestedSeason);host().hidden=false;elapsed=0;lastTime=0;render();paint();start();}
 function hide(){cancel();host().hidden=true;stop();clearSeason();}
 function demo(requestedSeason){window.HOJA_LOADING?.hide?.();window.HOJA_REPOSITORY?.hide?.();document.getElementById('hojaCatalog').hidden=true;show(requestedSeason);syncBack();}
 function frame(ctx,image,sx,sy,sw,sh,dx,dy,dw,dh,flip){if(!image?.complete||!image.naturalWidth)return;ctx.save();if(flip){ctx.translate(Math.round(dx+dw),0);ctx.scale(-1,1);dx=0;}ctx.drawImage(image,sx,sy,sw,sh,Math.round(dx),Math.round(dy),Math.round(dw),Math.round(dh));ctx.restore();}
  function paint(){
   const c=document.getElementById('hmSeasonCanvas');const ctx=c?.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;
   const viewport=c.parentElement?.getBoundingClientRect();
   if(!viewport?.width||!viewport.height)return;
   // Match the *entire* canvas aspect to the visible viewport. Uniform pixels,
   // no squeezed source textures, clipping line or separate hand-painted top.
   const logicalWidth=Math.max(240,Math.round(H*viewport.width/viewport.height));
   if(c.width!==logicalWidth||c.height!==H){c.width=logicalWidth;c.height=H;}
   W=logicalWidth;
   const theme=SEASONS[season];
   ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
   ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
   ctx.fillStyle=theme.sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   const worldScroll=Math.floor(elapsed*SHARED_SPEED);
   // Original seasonal parallax assets only. Repeat EACH source layer on its
   // natural 288px period, speed up towards the terrain, preserve tile boundaries.
   theme.bg.forEach((key,index)=>{
    const im=asset(key);if(!im?.naturalWidth)return;
    const width=im.naturalWidth*2;
    const speed=theme.bg.length===1?1:(.30+.70*(index/(theme.bg.length-1)));
    const shift=Math.floor(worldScroll*speed)%width;
    const y=G-im.naturalHeight*2+20;
    for(let x=-shift-width;x<W;x+=width)ctx.drawImage(im,Math.round(x),Math.round(y),width,im.naturalHeight*2);
   });
   // Foreground and V2 ground tiles use exactly the SAME 53px/s world offset.
   // All surfaces remain repeated, integer aligned, and drawn only from paV2Terrain.
   const terrain=asset('paV2Terrain');const tileShift=worldScroll%32;
   ctx.fillStyle=theme.ground;ctx.fillRect(0,G,W,H-G);
   if(terrain?.naturalWidth){
    const topY=theme.v2Family*16,bodyY=(theme.v2Family+1)*16,centerX=7*16;
    for(let x=-tileShift;x<W;x+=32){
     frame(ctx,terrain,centerX,topY,16,16,x,G,32,32);
     for(let y=G+32;y<H;y+=32)frame(ctx,terrain,centerX,bodyY,16,16,x,y,32,32);
    }
   }
   actors.forEach(a=>{
    const im=asset(a.key);if(!im?.naturalWidth)return;
    const x=((a.offset+elapsed*SHARED_SPEED)%TRAVEL_PERIOD)-90;
    const fps=a.type==='hoja'?12:a.type==='nahan'?10:8;
    const idx=Math.floor(elapsed*fps)%a.frames;
    let y=G-a.sz+3,w=a.sz,h=a.sz;
    if(a.type==='jumpy'){
     const cycle=(elapsed*2.45)%1;
     const lift=24*Math.max(0,Math.sin(cycle*Math.PI));
     h=Math.round(a.sz*(cycle<.12?.87:1));y=G-h+3-lift;
    }
    if(a.type==='owl')y=G-139+Math.sin(elapsed*2)*7;
    if(a.type==='ghost')y=G-118;
    frame(ctx,im,idx*a.sw,0,a.sw,a.sh,x,y,w,h,!!a.flip);
   });
  }
 function tick(t){if(host().hidden){raf=0;return;}if(lastTime)elapsed+=Math.min(.05,(t-lastTime)/1000);lastTime=t;paint();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
 function start(){if(!raf){lastTime=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}}
 function stop(){if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;lastTime=0;}
 return {show,hide,back,demo,get state(){return {stage,selection,teamCount,busy,season,sharedSpeed:SHARED_SPEED}}};
})();

</script>

<script>
/* V0.4.5 authoritative intro gate. Every "처음부터" goes through this.
   Starting screen is ALWAYS the 35-second HOJA Phaser attract, not repository. */
window.HOJA_FLOW=(()=>{
  function enterIntro({newRun=true}={}){
    if(newRun){window.HOJA_SEASON_SESSION.begin();window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.chooseNewRun?.();}
    else window.HOJA_SEASON_SESSION.current();
    window.HOJA_INTRO_SHORTCUT_LOGO=false;
    window.HOJA_INTRO_PENDING_PHASE2=false;
    window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY?.stop?.();
    document.getElementById('hojaGamePlay').hidden=true;
    window.HOJA_REPOSITORY?.hide?.();
    window.HOJA_LOADING?.hide?.();
    window.HOJA_CATALOG?.hide?.();
    window.HOJA_MODE_PREVIEW?.hide?.();
    for(const id of ['hojaRepoChoice','hojaCatalog','hojaNextMode','loadingOverlay','hojaSharedBack']){
      const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.hidden=true;
    }
    const logo=document.getElementById('hojaLogo');if(logo){logo.style.opacity='0';logo.style.transform='translate(-50%,-530px)';}
    const cut=document.getElementById('blackCut');if(cut)cut.style.opacity='0';
    const error=document.getElementById('hojaIntroError');error?.classList.remove('visible');
    window.HOJA_CATALOG?.syncBack?.();
  }
  function current(){
    if(!document.getElementById('hojaNextMode').hidden)return 'mode';
    if(!document.getElementById('hojaCatalog').hidden)return 'catalog';
    if(!document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').hidden)return 'loading';
    if(!document.getElementById('hojaRepoChoice').hidden)return 'repository';
    return 'intro';
  }
  return {enterIntro,current};
})();
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>window.HOJA_FLOW.enterIntro());
</script>

   Infinite QUIZ practice uses STEP13-7 balloonStatic + original quiz markup and style.
   Only mock quiz pool is currently available, NOT a Project B production question payload. */
const HOJA_V051_ARCADE_GZIP='
